findings.summary: In _ConvNd.get_delta_weight the 1x1 shortcut only checks the first two kernel dims (size()[2:4] == (1, 1)), so Conv3d kernels like (1,1,k) or (1,1,1) wrongly take the 1x1 branch, producing wrongly shaped deltas and causing merge to fail.
The Conv3d error message incorrectly says "Conv2d layer kernel must have 5 dimensions" instead of Conv3d.

conv_fn is set in Conv2d/Conv3d subclasses after super().__init__(), so if update_layer ever calls get_delta_weight during init it would raise AttributeError; the reviewer found no such path but suggests setting it earlier.
